columns.label: Digital Employee
columns.title: Subagent authorization must come from the root user, not forwarded claims
columns.title_zh: 子 Agent 授权必须来自真实 Root User，而不是转发声明
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260822-016 with Skill 02 score 46/50. MultiAgent V2 review receives bounded root-conversation context but only root user messages can establish authorization; summaries, review artifacts, assistant commentary and forwarded agent claims cannot. This creates a precise Digital Employee authority-provenance boundary across delegation.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260822-016，Skill 02 评分 46/50。MultiAgent V2 Review 可接收有界 Root Conversation Context，但只有 Root User Message 能建立授权；Summary、Review Artifact、Assistant Commentary 与转发的 Agent Claim 均不能形成权限。该机制为数字员工委派建立了明确的授权来源边界。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify how root conversation context is bounded, how genuine root-user authorization is distinguished from forwarded content, which review paths consume it, the handling of authorization changes, and regression coverage. Do not infer end-to-end authorization guarantees beyond the demonstrated review boundary.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Root Conversation Context 的有界方式、真实 Root User 授权与转发内容的区分、哪些 Review 路径消费该证据、授权变化如何处理及回归覆盖；不得推断超出已证明 Review 边界的端到端授权保证。

columns.label: Industry Architecture
columns.title: Remote execution policy must compose constraints without expanding capability
columns.title_zh: 远程执行策略必须组合约束，而不能借合并扩大能力
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260822-014 with Skill 02 score 46/50. Per-command attachment-owned network policy is composed with controller constraints and saved decisions while inherited domain/socket denies remain, strict allowlists cannot expand, and escalation cannot bypass owner policy. This is a strong architecture example of monotonic policy composition across multiple owners.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260822-014，Skill 02 评分 46/50。按命令解析的 Attachment-Owned Network Policy 与 Controller Constraint、已保存 Decision 组合，同时保留继承的 Domain/Socket Deny，Strict Allowlist 不可扩大，Escalation 也不能绕过 Owner Policy。这提供了多所有者约束下单调策略组合的高价值架构样本。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify the policy owners and merge order, how inherited denies and strict allowlists are represented, saved-decision scope, escalation rejection conditions, and regression tests. Do not generalize this into a claim that all remote-execution capabilities are non-expandable.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验策略所有者与合并顺序、继承 Deny 与 Strict Allowlist 的表示、Saved Decision 作用域、Escalation 拒绝条件及回归测试；不得泛化为所有远程执行能力都天然不可扩张。

columns.label: Open-source Engineering
columns.title: Plugin cache reconciliation needs account scope, serialization and generation guards
columns.title_zh: Plugin Cache 对账需要账号隔离、串行化与 Generation Guard
columns.source_zh: OpenAI Codex 维护者合并变更
columns.reason: Selected from SIG-20260822-007 with Skill 02 score 45/50. Installed-plugin snapshots are account-scoped, in-flight loads are discarded on account changes, reconciliation is serialized with installs/uninstalls, generations prevent stale overwrite, and the complete snapshot is validated before destructive cache changes. The mechanism combines identity isolation, concurrency control and stale-state rejection in one testable lifecycle.
columns.reason_zh: 选自 SIG-20260822-007，Skill 02 评分 45/50。Installed Plugin Snapshot 按账号隔离；账号变化会丢弃 In-Flight Load；Reconciliation 与安装/卸载串行化；Generation 防止旧刷新覆盖新状态，并在破坏性 Cache 变更前验证完整 Snapshot。该机制在一个可测试生命周期中组合了身份隔离、并发控制与旧状态拒绝。
columns.next: Skill 03 Deep Reading must verify snapshot identity, the serialization boundary, generation comparison, account-change invalidation, validation-before-destruction behavior, failure recovery and concurrency regression coverage. Do not infer transactional guarantees beyond the demonstrated cache lifecycle.
columns.next_zh: Skill 03 Deep Reading 需核验 Snapshot Identity、串行化边界、Generation 比较、账号变化失效、破坏前完整验证、失败恢复与并发回归覆盖；不得推断超出已证明 Cache 生命周期的事务保证。
